address: Rue de la Paix 22, Ixelles, 1050, Belgium
bio: The trendy natural interior of Savage is perfectly at home in the fashionable Saint-Boniface neighbourhood. The plant-based cuisine is depicted by fascinating combinations of herbs and vegetables, whose varied impressions and textures never fail to surprise. You can choose meat (from the refrigerated meat counter) or fish to accompany your meal, also selected according to sustainable development criteria....
